label: Reserve and infrastructure shortfall shared across cropping, pasture and non-agricultural land
description: A change to the method (three formulas in Settings!C55:E55). The workbook meets any shortfall of reserve and infrastructure land from non-agricultural land first, then pasture, then cropping, so a 30% reserve costs Australia nothing; here the shortfall is shared by cropping, pasture and non-agricultural land in proportion to their areas, in the sense of a reserve that is representative of the land (the Kunming-Montreal Target 3 asks for ecologically representative protected areas). Regions whose existing reserve already meets the setting are unchanged; the result falls where the reserve and infrastructure settings exceed the existing reserve.
errata: A method change recorded as an alternate (SCOPE.md E13). It treats arid non-agricultural land as equal to farmland for the purpose of the reserve; a reserve weighted toward the productive east and south-west would cost more, one in the rangelands less.
The short-term reserve setting is the raster share rounded to a whole percent, so the short term changes slightly where rounding makes it exceed the existing reserve.
